news.headline: 輝達董事會讓黃仁勳復職執行長
news.headline_en: NVIDIA board reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO
news.plain: 輝達董事會一致決議，黃仁勳即日起恢復總裁兼執行長與董事職務，代理執行長 Kress 回任財務長。董事會說美國政府高層的意見讓他們相信復職沒有國安風險，但針對他的獨立調查會繼續做完，並新設國安與出口管制委員會。股價今天開盤大漲約 3 成。
news.plain_en: NVIDIA's board unanimously reinstated Jensen Huang as president, CEO and director, effective immediately; interim CEO Kress returns to CFO. The board says input from senior US officials convinced it his return poses no national security risk, but the independent investigation will run to completion and a national security and export control committee was formed. Shares jumped about 30% at the open.
news.why_me: 你持有 81 股，今天大漲後占總資產約 22.09%，已超過 20%，該考慮減碼回 15～18%。執行長回來是好消息，但 SEC 會計調查還沒結束，照規則不加碼。
news.why_me_en: You hold 81 shares; after today's jump NVIDIA is about 22.09% of your assets, above 20%, so consider trimming to 15–18%. The CEO's return is good news, but the SEC accounting probe isn't over, so per your rules don't add.

news.headline: Reuters：美國證管會調查輝達會計處理
news.plain: Reuters 引述知情人士，美國證管會（SEC，類似台灣的金管會）執法人員正在檢查輝達可能的會計問題，消息傳出後輝達上週五單日跌約 13～14%。目前還不知道是哪些項目、會不會影響過去的財報數字。
news.plain_en: Reuters, citing people briefed on the matter, says SEC enforcement staff are examining possible accounting issues at NVIDIA; the stock fell about 13–14% on Friday. It is not yet clear which items are involved or whether past results could be affected.
news.why_me: 輝達會計調查還在進行，目前不知道會不會影響過去的財報；不要因為今天大漲就加碼，保留買進紀錄。
news.why_me_en: The accounting probe is still ongoing and it's unclear whether past results are affected; don't add just because of today's jump. Keep your purchase records.

news.headline: 國安基金護盤，台股反彈 778 點
news.headline_en: Stabilization fund steps in; TAIEX rebounds 778 points
news.plain: 台股今天盤中上下震盪 1,665 點，最後收漲 778 點、2.16%，收 36,811 點；台積電收 2,030 元，櫃買指數漲 2.88%。行政院長表示願意檢討擴大國安基金規模。
news.plain_en: TAIEX swung 1,665 points intraday before closing up 778 points (2.16%) at 36,811; TSMC closed at NT$2,030 and the OTC index rose 2.88%. The premier said the government is open to enlarging the stabilization fund.
news.why_me: 你的台積電、0050、00881 今天都跟著反彈。護盤能減緩下跌，但外資連 6 天賣超，不代表已經止跌；照計畫暫不增加台灣科技股。
news.why_me_en: Your TSMC, 0050 and 00881 all bounced today. Government buying can slow the fall, but foreign investors sold for a 6th straight day, so it doesn’t mean the bottom is in; per plan, don’t add Taiwan tech for now.
